messages:
Maria (DevEx): Quick report — minimal monorepo sample fails only on Vercel edge when sdk is symlinked from workspace. bundler error: "Package subpath './edge' is not defined by \"exports\" in /workspace/packages/js-sdk/package.json".

Maria (DevEx): Repro steps (short):
1) pnpm install (workspace)
2) cd examples/edge-sample && pnpm dev (vercel dev)
3) import Client from 'redwood-inference'
4) runtime throws during build/resolve

Maria (DevEx): package.json exports currently:```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
      "default": "./dist/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```
Note: no ./edge or ./browser mapping.

Maria (DevEx): Also seeing TS error in sample when hoisted types aren't picked up: "Could not find a declaration file for module 'redwood-inference'" despite types being under packages/js-sdk/dist/types/index.d.ts (pnpm symlinked). Works when we npm pack and install instead of workspace link.

Maria (DevEx): Separate but probably related: auth/retry oddness on edge — our client refreshes token on 401, but fetch wrapper in edge runtime retried the request and triggered concurrent refreshes -> 401 loop. Minimal log:```
[edge] request /api/predict -> 401
[edge] client.refreshToken() start
[edge] retry attempt 1 -> original call also triggers refresh -> stale token used -> 401 repeated
```

Kevin: Thanks — can you paste the bundler error stack? is this during build or runtime?

Maria (DevEx): Build time (esbuild/rollup in vercel dev). Stack: ```
Error: Package subpath './edge' is not defined by "exports" in /workspace/packages/js-sdk/package.json
    at resolver (/snapshot/rollup/node_modules/resolve/lib/async.js:...)
```

Kevin: Two quick paths: 1) add explicit export for ./edge to package.json pointing to ESM edge bundle, or 2) provide top-level "module" field + unambiguous entry so bundlers don't try subpath. Edge runtimes often prefer the browser/exports mapping.

Anya: Workaround we've used: add a tiny shim package in examples that re-exports the built ESM file with its own package.json (so the bundler resolves a real file, not a symlink). Ugly but fast for demos. Example: packages/examples/edge-shim/package.json -> { "name": "edge-shim", "main": "../js-sdk/dist/index.mjs", "types": "../js-sdk/dist/types/index.d.ts" }

Anya: Also for pnpm/ts: add "preserveSymlinks": true in vite/rollup resolver options sometimes helps, but not supported by Vercel build pipeline.

Sam: Action items on SDK side:
- Publish a dedicated ./edge export pointing at dist/edge/index.mjs (small bundle optimized for edge).
- Ensure types are declared at package root via "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" (so TS picks them up even when hoisted).
- Add "module" and "browser" fields to help bundlers.
- Investigate retry logic: make token refresh idempotent (single-flight) and detect in-flight refresh to avoid double-refresh in environments where fetch auto-retries.

Sam: Proposed minimal package.json patch:```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
      "default": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "module": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "browser": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```

Kevin: SGTM. +1 on single-flight refresh. For edge detection we can check typeof (globalThis.fetch) and request constructor differences but better to make refresh logic resilient regardless of runtime.

CI Bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/412 
Branch: fix/edge-exports-412

Maria (DevEx): Awesome — I'll attach the small repro (examples/edge-sample) to the issue and mark as P1 for onboarding blocker.

Anya: Quick note for docs: add a troubleshooting blurb about pnpm workspace symlinks + bundler pitfalls and recommend either publishing a local pack or using the shim until SDK patch lands.

Kevin: I'll take the PR for the package.json + types. Sam — can you own the retry single-flight?

Sam: Yea, I'll open a PR for single-flight refresh + a small edge test.

Maria (DevEx): Thanks all :pray: — saving this thread to the onboarding checklist.
